summary: Verified 3 new Ad Analytics Dashboard features: 1) Period comparison (GET /api/ads/analytics/compare), 2) Export reports (CSV/Excel), 3) Send weekly email report. All 15 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend UI verified: 4 tabs (realtime, financial, compare, alerts), export buttons, weekly report button all working correctly.

issues: Console warnings about chart dimensions (-1 width/height) when charts render - cosmetic only, charts display correctly

critical_code_review_comments: Compare endpoint (GET /api/ads/analytics/compare) returns period1, period2, changes with clicks/views/ctr/revenue/new_ads
Export endpoint (GET /api/ads/analytics/export) supports format=csv and format=excel with proper Arabic headers and BOM
Excel export creates 3 sheets: الإعلانات, الملخص المالي, الإيرادات حسب الموقع
Weekly report endpoint (POST /api/ads/analytics/send-weekly-report) sends HTML email to app owner
Frontend AdRealtimeDashboard.js properly implements all 4 tabs with data-testid attributes
Export buttons trigger file downloads correctly
All endpoints require super_admin authentication via require_super_admin dependency
seed_data_creation: None - used existing ad data (10 ads, 210 views, 1,650 EGP revenue)
